tool.name: Biomni: Setup Registration Method
tool.description: Setup the registration method with specified parameters.
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/setup_registration_method_wrapper.py' --output '$output' --transform '$transform' #if $metric --metric '$metric' #end if #if $optimizer --optimizer '$optimizer' #end if #if $learning_rate --learning_rate '$learning_rate' #end if #if $number_of_iterations --number_of_iterations '$number_of_iterations' #end if #if $gradient_convergence_tolerance --gradient_convergence_tolerance '$gradient_convergence_tolerance' #end if
tool.help:
**Biomni: Setup Registration Method**
Setup the registration method with specified parameters.
Args: transform: Transform object metric: Similarity metric name optimizer: Optimizer name learning_rate: Learning rate for gradient descent number_of_iterations: Maximum number of iterations gradient_convergence_tolerance: Convergence tolerance
Returns: Configured registration method
**Domain**: bioimaging **Function**: setup_registration_method
